implementation: Keep original range decoding and narrow-domain K16 QK carry, ordered softmax recurrence, native-PV arithmetic, original per-group error envelope, selected-cell predicate and original exact PV replay. The candidate changes query-origin addressing, fuses probability/native-PV and uses the previously checked register rescale operation.32/128-query variants independently expose the slab-size effect. The shared fused template defaults to its original short-context final-bound mode;15 native regressions check that mode. The512-group final-bound proof is not extended. No runtime dispatch changes.
correctness_scope: 100 generated configurations at10 shapes and5 operand families compare original QK/P/scales/native output/error/accumulator/denominator bits before replay and complete outputs after replay, with guards, range metadata and immutable raw operands. Shapes include partial tiles and key counts through264736. Each capture variant has one warmup and three timed complete passes: all outputs are compared against independently recomputed original arithmetic, and all pre-replay surfaces are compared on warmup. Original QK CPU dots provide an additional check. Every variant matches4194304 GB10 context cells. The8192-query diagnostic repeats1024 captured Q rows and extends K/V; only its first1024 query rows are GB10-anchored. No model inference acceptance follows.
timing_scope: Completed host clocks cover QK, probability/native-PV, candidate collection and exact replay for each slab. Allocation, reset, copies and independent checks are outside timing. Common range preparation and V transpose are reported separately; candidate domain preparation is added to comparison totals. Three attempt orders rotate the four routes after warmup. Static compiler resources are observations, not measured occupancy.
decision: Proceed to a separately gated provider implementation of the128-query complete long pipeline and real-model correctness-attached comparison. Both captured component shapes improve consistently, but32-query fusion alone regresses. Retained q8192 model performance remains23353.80795ms until a new product gate establishes a replacement.
